instruction: Navigate to recreation.gov and find the 'Site' column header in the campground search results.

metadata.explanation: Task variation targeting the fifth column header (index 4) which should be 'Site'. Follows the same pattern as the original task but examines a different table column. Uses existing Chrome HTML parsing capabilities (active_tab_html_parse and check_direct_json_object).

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete verification: Evaluator only checks if text 'Site' exists in class 'camp-sortable-column-header' at index 4, but does NOT verify navigation to recreation.gov
Missing context validation: Does not verify that user actually performed a search or that campground search results are displayed
No URL verification: Config has 'goto_prefix' but it's not used in validation - evaluator could pass on any page with matching class name
Logical flaw: Task requires finding column header 'in the campground search results' but evaluator has no way to confirm search results context - could pass if homepage has same class element
Fragile selector: Hardcoded index 4 with no verification that this actually corresponds to 'Site' column in current search results
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add URL verification: Use get_active_url_from_accessTree to verify active tab URL contains 'recreation.gov' and indicates search results (e.g., URL contains search parameters)
Add context verification: Verify presence of search results indicators (e.g., check for search result container elements or multiple camp-sortable-column-header elements)
Use goto_prefix in expected rules: Add URL matching logic to check_direct_json_object or use separate URL verification step
Consider more robust selector: Instead of hardcoded index, verify 'Site' exists among all column headers rather than requiring specific position
Add multi-step verification: Split into (1) verify on recreation.gov search results page, (2) verify 'Site' column exists
